wages.text: She co-leads the Raise the Wage Act of 2025 to raise the federal minimum wage and has a long record of backing minimum-wage increases and labor.
wages.quote: raises the minimum wage and empowers more American workers

trade.text: She criticized new tariffs as driving up everyday costs for families.
trade.quote: massive new tariffs that would raise everyday costs

housing.text: A self-described YIMBY who leads House Democrats' housing affordability effort, she pushes to cut red tape and build more homes.
housing.quote: the red tape holding Angelenos back from being able to afford a roof over their heads

immigration.text: She backs restoring oversight and civil rights protections to immigration enforcement and co-leads the No Masks for ICE Act.
immigration.quote: Restores oversight and civil rights protections to immigration enforcement.

guns.text: She led gun-violence-prevention efforts in the Assembly and holds Giffords and Gun Sense Voter endorsements.
guns.quote: she led efforts to combat climate change, prevent gun violence, protect reproductive freedom, defend the LGBTQ+ community, and expand housing affordability

abortion.text: She affirms a right to abortion care and leads legislation to restore Medicaid funding to Planned Parenthood.
abortion.quote: Every person has the basic right to emergency health care, including abortion care.

gender.text: Opposed policies targeting transgender people, including restrictions on gender-affirming care and transgender service members.
gender.quote: Friedman has also taken the administration to task on its attacks on the transgender community, and has taken action to oppose the elimination of life-saving gender affirming care, restrictive passport gender markers, and the ban on transgender service members.

health.text: She opposed Republican Medicaid cuts and has co-authored single-payer healthcare legislation.
health.quote: condemning Americans to higher healthcare costs and less access to healthcare

energy.text: A career climate legislator, she affirms the need to confront the climate crisis and opposed withdrawing from the Paris Agreement.
energy.quote: this resolution affirms the need for global cooperation to confront the climate crisis and protect our planet

voting.text: Criticized proof-of-citizenship mandates and restrictions on mail voting as measures that make voting harder for eligible Americans.
voting.quote: While our election security infrastructure is being dismantled, this administration is simultaneously making it harder for eligible Americans to vote — pushing proof-of-citizenship mandates, demanding voter rolls from states, restricting mail-in voting, and threatening federal enforcement at polling places,

tax.text: Meyers' campaign platform calls for lower taxes and less federal spending as core affordability commitments.
tax.quote: Fight for lower taxes and pro-growth policies

trade.text: He backs trade policies aimed at keeping American entertainment-industry jobs in the U.S.
trade.quote: Support tax and trade policies that keep American entertainment jobs in America

housing.text: He wants to cut regulations he says drive up housing costs.
housing.quote: Cut regulatory red tape that drives up housing and small business costs

safety.text: He calls for supporting law enforcement and restoring criminal consequences.
safety.quote: Support law enforcement and restore consequences for crime

immigration.text: He supports securing the southern border, aggressive drug-trafficking enforcement, and opposing sanctuary policies.
immigration.quote: Support strong leadership to secure the southern border

energy.text: He backs American energy independence framed as a way to reduce gas and utility costs.
energy.quote: Support American energy independence to lower gas and utility costs

voting.text: He supports voter ID requirements and proof-of-citizenship measures like the SAVE Act.
voting.quote: Confidence in elections is foundational to democracy.
